back_translation: Woe to those who devise wickedness and plot evil on their beds! As soon as morning dawns they carry it out, because it is within the power of their hand.
They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them away; they oppress a homeowner and his house, a man and his inheritance.
Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am devising disaster against this clan, from which you cannot remove your necks; you will not walk haughtily, for it will be an evil time.

In that day someone will take up a taunt against you and wail a bitter lament, saying, 'We are utterly ruined! He changes the portion of my people; how He has taken it away from me, and divides our fields among traitors.'
Therefore you will have no one left to cast the measuring line by lot to apportion land in the assembly of the LORD.
They say, 'Do not preach!' These people preach, 'One must not preach about such things; disgrace will not overtake us.'
O house of Jacob, should this be said? Has the Spirit of the LORD run out of patience? Are these His doings? Do not My words do good to the one who walks uprightly?
But lately My people have risen up as an enemy; you strip the costly robe from those who pass by trustingly, from those with no thought of war.
You drive the women of My people out of their pleasant homes, and from their little children you take away My splendor forever.
Arise and depart, for this is not your place of rest, because of the uncleanness that brings destruction—a grievous destruction.
If a man walking in wind and falsehood were to utter a lie, saying, 'I will preach to you of wine and strong drink,' he would be just the preacher for this people!

O Jacob, I will surely gather all of you; I will surely assemble the remnant of Israel. I will put them together like sheep in a fold, like a flock in the midst of its pasture, noisy with the multitude of people.
The one who breaks open the way goes up before them; they break through, pass the gate, and go out by it. Their king passes on before them, and the LORD is at their head leading them.
